# Discord Media
> Discord Media hosts Discord’s developer-facing media and rich presence documentation, assets, and integration resources.

This site provides technical guidance for Discord application integrations, including Rich Presence, embedded assets, and related developer materials used by game and app developers.

## Developer Platform
- [Discord Developer Portal](https://discord.com/developers/docs/intro): Entry point for Discord’s developer documentation and platform concepts.
- [Applications](https://discord.com/developers/applications): Manage Discord applications, OAuth2 settings, and integration configuration.
- [API Documentation](https://discord.com/developers/docs/reference): Core reference for Discord APIs, objects, and platform behavior.
- [OAuth2](https://discord.com/developers/docs/topics/oauth2): Authentication and authorization flows for Discord integrations.
- [Activities](https://discord.com/developers/docs/activities/overview): Build embedded social experiences and activities for Discord.

## Rich Presence
- [Rich Presence Overview](https://discord.com/developers/docs/rich-presence/overview): Introduction to Discord Rich Presence capabilities and integration concepts.
- [How to Use Rich Presence](https://discord.com/developers/docs/rich-presence/how-to): Setup guidance for displaying game and app activity in Discord.
- [Best Practices](https://discord.com/developers/docs/rich-presence/best-practices): Recommendations for effective, user-friendly Rich Presence implementations.
- [Assets](https://discord.com/developers/docs/rich-presence/overview#assets): Use uploaded application art and media in Rich Presence payloads.

## Game SDK
- [Game SDK Overview](https://discord.com/developers/docs/game-sdk/sdk-starter-guide): Starter guide for integrating Discord features into games.
- [Activities and Status](https://discord.com/developers/docs/game-sdk/activities): Manage activity state, timestamps, and party information.
- [Users](https://discord.com/developers/docs/game-sdk/users): Access Discord user information within Game SDK integrations.
- [Relationships](https://discord.com/developers/docs/game-sdk/relationships): Work with friend and relationship data exposed by the SDK.
- [Lobbies](https://discord.com/developers/docs/game-sdk/lobbies): Create and manage multiplayer lobbies through Discord services.
- [Networking](https://discord.com/developers/docs/game-sdk/networking): Peer networking support for connected multiplayer experiences.
- [Voice](https://discord.com/developers/docs/game-sdk/voice): Integrate Discord voice features into game experiences.
- [Storage](https://discord.com/developers/docs/game-sdk/storage): Persist small amounts of user data with SDK storage APIs.

## Embedded App Assets
- [Application Assets](https://discord.com/developers/docs/rich-presence/overview#assets): Upload and reference image assets for Rich Presence and app displays.
- [Developer Applications](https://discord.com/developers/applications): Configure application metadata, icons, and linked integration settings.
- [Art and Branding](https://discord.com/branding): Official Discord branding resources and usage guidance.
- [Safety and Policy](https://discord.com/guidelines): Community and platform guidelines relevant to app developers.

## API Reference
- [Reference](https://discord.com/developers/docs/reference): Global API conventions, versions, and shared reference information.
- [Rate Limits](https://discord.com/developers/docs/topics/rate-limits): Understand Discord API rate limiting behavior and handling.
- [Gateway](https://discord.com/developers/docs/topics/gateway): Real-time event connection model for Discord applications.
- [Gateway Events](https://discord.com/developers/docs/topics/gateway-events): Event payloads and dispatch behavior for Gateway consumers.
- [Opcodes and Status Codes](https://discord.com/developers/docs/topics/opcodes-and-status-codes): Gateway opcodes, close codes, and related protocol details.
- [Permissions](https://discord.com/developers/docs/topics/permissions): Permission model for bots, apps, and guild resources.

## SDKs and Libraries
- [Game SDK Download](https://discord.com/developers/docs/game-sdk/sdk-starter-guide): Official starting point for Discord Game SDK usage.
- [Discord Social SDK](https://discord.com/developers/docs/social-sdk/overview): Overview of Discord’s social integration SDK for games and apps.
- [Social SDK Authentication](https://discord.com/developers/docs/social-sdk/authentication): Authenticate users and connect app sessions with Discord.
- [Social SDK Relationships](https://discord.com/developers/docs/social-sdk/relationships): Access social graph and relationship features through the Social SDK.
- [Social SDK Presence](https://discord.com/developers/docs/social-sdk/presence): Publish and consume presence information using Social SDK features.

## Guides
- [Getting Started](https://discord.com/developers/docs/intro): Learn the basics of building on the Discord platform.
- [OAuth2 Guide](https://discord.com/developers/docs/topics/oauth2): Implement Discord login and authorization for applications.
- [RPC Deprecation Context](https://discord.com/developers/docs/rich-presence/how-to): Current Rich Presence guidance replacing older RPC workflows.
- [Activities Overview](https://discord.com/developers/docs/activities/overview): Start building embedded Discord activities and shared app experiences.
- [Application Commands](https://discord.com/developers/docs/interactions/application-commands): Define slash commands and other application command interfaces.
- [Interactions Overview](https://discord.com/developers/docs/interactions/overview): Build interactive app experiences with Discord interactions.

## Policies and Support
- [Developer Terms of Service](https://discord.com/developers/docs/policies-and-agreements/developer-terms-of-service): Terms governing use of Discord developer tools and APIs.
- [Developer Policy](https://discord.com/developers/docs/policies-and-agreements/developer-policy): Policy requirements for apps, bots, and developer platform usage.
- [Platform Overview](https://discord.com/developers/docs/policies-and-agreements/overview): Overview of policies and agreements for Discord developers.
- [Community Guidelines](https://discord.com/guidelines): Rules and expectations relevant to Discord platform participation.
- [Support](https://support.discord.com): Official support resources for Discord products and developer-adjacent issues.
